trigger: The second execution stopped before creating an output because the final complete control day ended exactly at the sealed corpus boundary and therefore had no following H1 bar object.
amendment: When a complete 24-hour path ends exactly at the sealed corpus boundary, use the final H1 bar close as the terminal 00:00 UTC price; otherwise continue requiring the next bar open.
equivalence_condition: The H1 corpus is gap-free and every preceding bar close_time equals the next bar open_time; the fallback is allowed only when the final path bar close_time exactly equals the requested terminal timestamp.
scope_note: This repairs an exact corpus-end representation before any result artifact. It does not select or remove a day based on its BTC outcome.
